messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video, then follow the described camera setup and movement. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands and slowly turns her head and upper body from facing right to facing more toward the camera.","camera":"A medium shot at eye level that remains mostly static while the subject rotates slightly.","clothing":"A short, form-fitting dress with a busy multicolored pattern of purple, blue, yellow, and red shapes on a dark background.","hair_color":"Black with a prominent gray streak in the bangs.","hairstyle":"Black hair with straight bangs across the forehead and a low bun at the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin, a slender build, and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"An outdoor courtyard with stone buildings, metal railings, pipes, rocks, and green hills under a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output changes from a rear view of the woman walking away on a seaside terrace to a front three-quarter upper-body/medium shot in a stone courtyard. The subject is now facing toward the camera, with the same colorful dress, dark skin, and similar hairstyle, and she slowly turns her head and upper body. The environment is no longer the seaside terrace but a courtyard with buildings, pipes, railings, rocks, and hills.
arguments.requested_change: Switch to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while retaining the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, environment, timing, and progression.
uncertain: Whether the output's initial framing and subject placement exactly match the provided reference image.
Whether the timing and progression of the action were preserved relative to the source video.
unexpected_changes: The environment changed from a seaside terrace to a stone courtyard with buildings, pipes, and rocks.
The subject's action changed from walking away to standing and turning toward the camera.
The hairstyle appears different, with straight bangs and a low bun instead of the source's two low buns.
The framing is closer and more upper-body than the source's full-body rear view.
